The main takeaway from our work is that
the ligand sensitivity of KATP channels depends on the relative lifetime of the channel spent in a ligand sensitive state.

the response of cardiac ATP-sensitive K+ channels to inhibitory ligands (ATP or sulfonylureas) is not determined by their ability to bind to the channel, but rather by the relative lifetime they spend in a ligand-insensitive state.
ligand-insensitive state of cardiac KATp channels is not necessarily the result of a channel mutation.
